title: Stack-adapter packs resolve deterministically and report ambiguity
statement: A stack-adapter pack MUST be a resolution candidate only when its stack-adapter.json validates against law/schemas/stack-adapter.schema.json, an explicitly named pack MUST take precedence over detection and resolve to nothing when absent, detection MUST rank matching packs by signal hits, then declared priority, then id, and MUST report a tie at the top as ambiguous, and sensor parameters MUST come only from the resolved pack under an explicitly supplied packs root, with no resolution when that root is absent.
rationale: Article 1 admits adjacent stacks only through stack-adapter packs carried as F5 policy and requires each adopter to declare one resolved stack; a silent tie or a pack found outside the declared root would change extraction without a declaration.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
